external_file_rule: Every external file materialized by stages 24-40 must be exact-hash bound to an upstream authority or manifest contract; moving aliases latest/current/newest are forbidden.

components.boundary_overrides: Optional list of ComponentBoundaryConstraintIR-like rows. Overrides only existing local-relation adjacency and require evidence_refs.

carrier_policy.decisions: Optional explicit component_id -> MESH|PLANAR rows with evidence_refs. Missing components conservatively default to MESH. CLIP is forbidden here.

deformation_envelope.joint_ranges: Required exact row for every qualified joint; V1 rotation stress requires translation_radius=0 and scale=[1,1].

observation.qualified_observation_authority: Stage 07 must output RealSaS.QualifiedObservationSetIR.v1 with exact 8 source-observation hashes, source-raster byte hashes, foreground-mask hashes, camera-binding hashes and qualified states.
observation.source_foreground_masks: Exactly 8 rows: view_index, mask:{path,sha256}. Materialized bytes are not independent authority; each sha256 must equal the corresponding stage-07 foreground_mask_sha256.
observation.component_masks: Exactly 8 x admitted-component rows: view_index, component_id, mask:{path,sha256}. Rows must form a disjoint and complete partition of the exact stage-07 source foreground for that view.
observation.g5_visibility: Predicted component masks are the canonical mesh z-buffer visible-owner masks under the exact authoritative camera; smaller camera-forward Z wins and exact-depth ties use a stable lexical face key.
observation.camera_bundle: Stage 05 input: exact RealSaS.CameraProjectionBundle.v1 file ref {path,sha256}. Stage 05 emits QualifiedCameraSetIR; downstream camera consumers may not refit or independently reload a second camera authority.
observation.source_rasters: Exactly 8 rows: view_index, image:{path,sha256}. Materialized bytes are not independent authority; each sha256 must equal the corresponding stage-07 source_raster_sha256.

presentation.structure: MechanicalPartition components become independently addressable slots without categorical object recognition. Exact skin may prove RIGID ownership; rigidity never implies detachability.
presentation.appearance: One canonical QualifiedMesh is reused for all eight views. Each face has exactly one observed donor view; target-local donor is preferred, cross-view color blending is forbidden, and no common observed donor fails closed.
presentation.composition: Physical occlusion is canonical z-buffer visible-owner authority bound to G5. Slot setup order is UI/editing baseline only and cannot independently solve physical occlusion.
presentation.current_limit: Automatic PLANAR proxy-plane production and qualified visual completion are not implemented; either condition blocks stage 30 rather than inventing authority.

rest_render.authority: Stage 31 is a deterministic consumer of exact QualifiedMeshIR + QualifiedPresentationGraph sub-authorities + QualifiedCameraSetIR + stage-07 source raster identities.
rest_render.rgb_rule: Canonical geometry is visibility/deformation carrier only. RGB/RGBA comes exclusively from exact source rasters. Lighting, shading, relighting and completion are forbidden.
rest_render.donor_rule: One donor view per face. Visible donor provenance is counted as DIRECT_SOURCE vs CROSS_VIEW_SOURCE for stage-32 admission.
rest_render.output: RealSaS.RestRenderSetIR.v1 plus eight PNG evidence transports. Raw RGBA SHA in RestRenderSetIR is authority; PNG is evidence transport only.

appearance.rest_preservation_policy: Exact {path,sha256} to canonical/REST_SOURCE_PRESERVATION_POLICY_V1_20260919.json or byte-identical sealed equivalent. Policy is re-derived and drift-checked at stage 32.
appearance.rest_preservation_calibration: Exact {path,sha256} to canonical/REST_SOURCE_PRESERVATION_CALIBRATION_RESULT_20260919.json or byte-identical sealed equivalent. Knight/Mage outcomes may not tune thresholds.
appearance.stage32_rule: Consumes exact stage-07 source raster/foreground authority, stage-26 MeshQualificationPolicyIR and stage-31 RestRenderSetIR. Every one of eight views must pass every hard rule; aggregate compensation is forbidden.
appearance.coordinate_domains: Observation PIXEL_CENTER_XY is source texel index-centered; Runtime/G5 target raster uses half-integer pixel centers. Rest rendering must preserve this distinction and may not add an extra half-pixel shift.

motion.sources: Non-empty motion.sources list. INLINE_PRESET_SPEC_V1 is parameter-space source identity; EXTERNAL_ARTIST_CLIP_V1 must resolve an exact-hash RealSaS.MotionSourceClip.v1 file. SOURCE_RIG_TRACKS_V1 is source evidence only and is not implicitly retargeted.
motion.stage33_rule: Consumes exact Stage-29 CanonicalPuppetStateIR and Stage-32 QualifiedRestSourcePreservationIR. It may seal source identity and run authorization only; retargeting, motion compilation and motion-quality claims are forbidden at Stage 33.
motion.stage34_boundary: Every Stage-33 seal declares Stage-34 compilation required. Rotation-only procedural presets are mechanical probes, not professional artist-motion evidence.
motion.stage34_rule: Stage 34 consumes exact Stage-18/25/29/30/33 authorities. SOURCE_RIG_TRACKS_V1 requires an explicit one-to-one retarget map; Stage-25 deformation envelope is a hard limit. Stage 34 claims compiled mechanics only.
motion.stage35_rule: Stage 35 executes exact Stage-34 tracks as canonical 3D FK/LBS over the single Stage-27 QualifiedMeshIR and Stage-28 QualifiedMeshSkinIR, samples authored/contact boundaries plus a frozen uniform grid, proves contacts and dynamic conditioning, and forbids per-view motion-mesh truth.

runtime.stage36: Projects exact Stage-35 canonical 3D frames into compact Runtime-v4. Face-corner deployment expansion is allowed only for UV seams and every projected vertex retains an exact source canonical vertex id. Source texture PNGs are transport-only re-encodings of exact Stage-07 raster authority.
runtime.stage37: Materializes the existing streamed Runtime-v4 writer without solver/FK/LBS replay. Package source authority is RUNTIME_V4_ADMISSION_CERTIFICATE, not a premature full ProductProofBundle claim.
runtime.native_player: Stages 38-39 require runtime.native_player:{path,sha256}. The exact-hash native executable must open/render the .rss through RUNTIME_V4_SHARED_CANONICAL_DEPTH_REFERENCE.
runtime.stage38: One native playback probe for every clip x 8 views; visible alpha and exact framebuffer size are required.
runtime.stage39: Native render bake at every Stage-36 projected frame time x 8 views. RGBA sequence hashes establish visible temporal change; no founder visual pass is fabricated.

closure.stage40: PRODUCT_PASS requires Stage-32 every-view rest preservation, Stage-35 dynamic proof, at least one nonzero ARTIST_SOURCE clip, exact Stage-37 package, Stage-38 native playback, and visible native Stage-39 change for every professional artist-motion clip.
closure.mechanical_probe_rule: MECHANICAL_PROBE_ONLY cannot mint PRODUCT_PASS by itself.
closure.json_only_rule: JSON-only metrics cannot mint PRODUCT_PASS; native visual motion evidence is mandatory.

preflight.stage03: Reads exact Stage-01 source byte seal plus observation raster/foreground refs. Requires eight non-empty raw binary foreground masks and a preregistered nonzero border safety margin.
preflight.stage04: Admits only CONTROLLED_FULL_SUBJECT_8VIEW_V1 after Stage-03 PASS. Out-of-frame remains UNKNOWN and cannot be treated as negative evidence.
preflight.stage06: Materializes the exact eight source observations; no synthetic redraw or appearance generation.
preflight.stage07: Mints QualifiedObservationSetIR binding exact raster SHA, foreground-mask SHA and exact camera hash for every view.
preflight.stage08: Seals explicit REALSAS_OBJECT_FRAME center/half-extent normalization; no camera refit.

learned_execution.common: IRIS/Geppetto/Arachne heavy fitting is represented by a preregistered exact-source execution receipt. Receipt status alone is not product authority: prereg hash, model-source SHA, checkpoint/result/proposal SHA and upstream lineages must all match. Teacher inference inputs are forbidden.
learned_execution.iris: Stages 09-11 preregister/verify/seal the IRIS fit. Stage 12 admits an exact signed-zero-surface NPZ bound to the checkpoint, observation set and normalization domain.
learned_execution.geometry: Stage 13 performs eight-view source-foreground reprojection against explicit preregistered global and connected-component thresholds. Stage 14 performs bounded subject-free substrate adequacy search over the dense signed zero-surface; N is selected as the smallest actual passing mechanical carrier set under explicit geometric/normal/projected/component tolerances, not a fixed product constant. Stage 15 requires exact adequacy-report binding plus current lossless Geppetto RiggingSurface tensorization.
learned_execution.geppetto: Stages 16-17 admit only exact SkeletonProposalIR evidence. Stage 18 alone mints QualifiedSkeletonIR through Compiler.qualify_skeleton; Stage 19 seals checkpoint+qualified lineage.
learned_execution.arachne: Stages 20-21 admit only exact SkinProposalIR evidence. Stage 22 alone mints QualifiedSkinIR through Compiler.qualify_skin with preregistered bounded repair policy; Stage 23 seals checkpoint+qualified lineage.

gsa.adequacy_policy: Required subject-free bounded search policy: min/max candidate nodes, growth/refinement budget, dense-to-S spatial error, normal error, projected carrier spacing, dense-component preservation and aliasing limits. target_nodes as a fixed product decision is superseded.
gsa.selection_rule: Stage14 selects the minimum actual node count among passing evaluated candidates; no character name or categorical recognition may affect selection.

external_fit_manifest_contract.proposal_ref: required for Geppetto/Arachne; exact SkeletonProposalIR/SkinProposalIR JSON
